# Site Clearance (Kardashev Labs)

> Draw a search area in ERCOT and get a county-level strong / mixed / weak clearance estimate from public GIS queue data, measured interconnection timelines, and LMP market stress. Not an official ERCOT interconnection study.

Site Clearance is a free public tool. Generator projects in ERCOT GIS filings have county, not lat/lon, so scores are county-resolution. Wire stress and SCED curtailment are not in the v1 grade.

## Pages

- [Map tool](https://clearance.kardashevlabs.org/): draw polygon or pick a county, score generation or coarse large-load MW
- [Methodology](https://clearance.kardashevlabs.org/methodology): geography, grade inputs, exclusions, sources

## Related

- [Kardashev Labs](https://kardashevlabs.org/)
- [Interconnection timelines](https://interconnection-queue.kardashevlabs.org/interconnection-timelines)
- Score API: `POST https://data.kardashevlabs.org/clearance/score` (when deployed)
